function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies the caller's identity before any debt information is disclosed. Call this in STATE 1 with the code spoken by the customer. The response field 'verified' is a hard gate — do NOT disclose any debt details or transition to STATE 2 unless verified is true.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account identifier. Always use ACC-88392 for this session.

verification_code.description: The code spoken by the customer — either the last 4 digits of their PAN card or their 4-digit year of birth.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Records the customer's commitment to pay the overdue amount by a specific date. Call this in STATE 3 Branch A after the customer agrees to pay. Resolve any relative date (e.g. 'this Friday', 'tomorrow') to ISO-8601 format before calling.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account identifier. Always use ACC-88392 for this session.

ptp_date.description: The date the customer committed to pay, in ISO-8601 format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-08-14.

amount.description: The amount the customer agreed to pay in INR. Default to 8499 unless the customer explicitly negotiates a different amount.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Dispatches an instant payment link to the customer's registered mobile number via the specified channel. Call this in STATE 3 Branch A immediately after log_promise_to_pay succeeds.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account identifier. Always use ACC-88392 for this session.

channel.description: The delivery channel for the payment link. Default to SMS unless the customer requests WhatsApp or both.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final outcome of the call. MUST be called in every terminal path before ending the call — PTP agreed, already paid, DNC, wrong person, escalation, and no response. Never end the call without calling this tool.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account identifier. Always use ACC-88392 for this session.

status.description: The final call outcome to log. PTP_AGREED: customer committed to pay. ALREADY_PAID: customer claims payment was made. DISPUTED: customer contests the debt. HARDSHIP_ESCALATED: escalated due to financial hardship. WRONG_PERSON: answerer is not the target customer. DO_NOT_CALL: customer requested opt-out. NO_RESPONSE: no input received or auth failed twice.

notes.description: Optional free-text context about the outcome, e.g. payment mode mentioned, dispute reason, or hardship details.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Transfers the call to a human collections agent when the customer reports financial hardship or disputes the debt. Call this in STATE 3 Branch C (hardship) or Branch D (dispute). After this tool returns, you must still call mark_disposition with HARDSHIP_ESCALATED or DISPUTED before ending the call.

reason.description: The reason for escalating to a human agent. Use HARDSHIP_REQUEST when the customer cannot pay due to financial difficulty. Use DISPUTE when the customer does not recognise or contests the debt amount.
